title: Nearby Node Decision Layers — Onboarding explainer and screenshot kit
creator: Asha Kaplan
description: Deliver a compact onboarding tile set and accompanying documentation screenshots that explain how Redwood routes requests to the nearest healthy serving node. Focus is on a layered explainer that visually separates: 1) inference request entry, 2) latency measurement and node scoring, 3) routing decision with fallbacks, and 4) developer-facing console view showing route selection and cost/latency tradeoffs. Deliverables: Figma file with low/hi-fidelity tiles, 3 annotated screenshots for the Quickstart, a short 45s animated GIF showing decision flow, and a condensed markdown explainer for docs. Emphasize clarity for engineers new to region steering and platform-level fallbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Figma: 6 tiles (intro, measurement, scoring, decision, fallback, console) in both light and dark
3 PNG export screenshots sized for Quickstart page (1200x640) with callouts
Animated GIF demonstrating a request reroute after simulated node degradation
Docs-ready markdown snippet with image references and alt text
Design sign-off from PM and Eng (comments addressed)
screenshot_notes: Quickstart hero: 3-panel composition showing request origin -> chosen node -> response; overlay latency labels (ms)
Console route inspector: highlight selected policy (latency-prefer) and show recent latency histogram and cost estimate line
Fallback example: show initial chosen node in red (degraded) and automatic reroute to secondary with minimal token delay annotation
assets_needed: SVG map tiles (regional boundaries with subtle color strata)
Icon set: request, node, heartbeat, cache, fallback arrow
Console UI mock: route inspector panel and cost breakdown bar
design_decisions: Use layered visual language rather than literal world maps to reduce cognitive load for quickstarts
Prefer abstracted nodes with proximity rings to illustrate latency without implying exact geography
Show deterministic decision path followed by dashed fallback path to communicate graceful degradation
Annotate cost impact only in the console screenshot to avoid overwhelming onboarding hero
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Users may conflate proximity with legal data residency — Mitigation: add explicit note in docs about region vs. residency
Risk: Map detail could be misconstrued as SLA guarantee — Mitigation: use stylized regions and include microcopy about variability
Risk: Animated GIF size may be large for docs — Mitigation: provide both GIF and APNG/web-optimized video and lazy-load in docs
notes_for_engineering: Coordinate with ENG-2876 to capture realistic latency numbers for sample histograms
Ask runtime team for a reproducible degraded-node scenario to record real reroute timings
Provide console mock data in JSON lines format for frontend to render the screenshots exactly
